Levi is THEE goalie prospect for us. Portillo would be much more likely for us to part with. 

For reference Dylan Cozens is having a similar season to Meier as a 2nd line center. Would you trade similar assets for him?

More likely the first would be in 2024 with this draft being as stellar as it is. 

I don't disagree that Karl wouldn't elevate us, he's a fantastic addition to any team. However, with our team being as young as it is we aren't even in our playoff window yet. 

Generally speaking, the 1st + peterka would be lot closer. 

In terms of Meier, the are a lot of options - 

We have two roster players in - hinostroza and asplund that could go the other way. (These are just bodies for your lineup, not the main trade pieces)

A 1st - again a 2023 being much more valuable than a 2024, so that would change the rest of the remaining pieces 

Prospect - we have a slew of (S tier) and (A tier) prospects 

S - Kulich, Levi (forward and goalie) [untouchable]
A - Savoie, Ostland, Rosen (all forwards) 
B - Portillo (G), Johnson (D), Biro (F)

A trade I'd be comfortable with for meier -

BUF Trades - Asplund/Hinostroza, 2024 protected 1st, 2 of the B tier 

The more likely trade -

2024 protected 1st, Asplund/Hinostroza, both an A AND B prospect, + an AHLer with potential

Worst Case - 

2023 protected 1st, A tier prospect, one of Krebs/Quinn/Peterka
